title: PatronStaking
tagline: A patron platform that encourages long-term activities by staking USDC on individuals such as OSS contributors, public goods builder, and researchers working in DAO forums. Will be a public good and new ERC standard; NO management fee
description:
Stake for individuals. Unlike Gitcoin, this is not a one-time donation transfer, but rather an ongoing distribution of investment profits from staked crypto money.
This is a patron platform that encourages activities from a long-term perspective by staking USDC on individuals" such as OSS contributors, builders of public goods, and researchers working in DAO forums, and providing them with continuous financial support. We do not take any management fees and will build as a public good.
how_its_made:
This is how it's made
We used Tableland for our database 
We supabase  for our Github OAuth
We used Next.js, Tailwind, RainbowKit  in part of our frontend
We created a smart contract for Staking for individuals. which we will submit as a ERC in future work
Will integrate with RWA of US Treasuries, such as OpenEden, Ondo Finance, Maple Finance
